title: Optimization and physics-prior diagnosis for the full learned SwiLA PLM
question: Did the failed full-learned PLM attempt actually optimize, and is the registered Hamiltonian prior materially constraining optimization?
purpose: Diagnose the failure of TACOSM-PLM-FULL-LEARNED-SWILA-001 without changing its benchmark, architecture, seeds, data pools, or training schedule.

interventions.name: untrained
interventions.description: Instantiate the exact full-learned model at the registered seed and run the registered evaluation with zero optimizer updates.

interventions.name: trained_full
interventions.description: Repeat the registered full-learned training protocol exactly, including PHYSICS_WEIGHT=0.03.

interventions.name: trained_physics_off
interventions.description: Repeat the registered full-learned training protocol exactly with only PHYSICS_WEIGHT set to 0.0; all other settings remain fixed.

decision_rule.condition: Untrained control matches the registered model/evaluation interface and is evaluated without optimizer updates
decision_rule.licenses: The chance/floor behavior of the exact architecture and benchmark can be characterized.

decision_rule.condition: A trained arm shows >=10% reduction from mean loss over steps 1-20 to mean loss over steps 201-220 and changes its parameters
decision_rule.licenses: Evidence that optimization occurred rather than a no-update or frozen-weight harness failure.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Evidence that optimization reached useful capability.

decision_rule.condition: trained action accuracy exceeds untrained accuracy by >=0.05 absolute
decision_rule.licenses: Evidence that training moved the model beyond its exact untrained evaluation floor on this benchmark.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Evidence of architectural superiority or successful PLM capability.

decision_rule.condition: trained_physics_off exceeds trained_full action accuracy by >=0.05 absolute with the same integrity conditions
decision_rule.licenses: Evidence that the registered Hamiltonian prior is a material optimization/capability constraint under this protocol.
decision_rule.does_not_license: A claim that the physics prior is intrinsically harmful in other tasks or architectures.

decision_rule.condition: No registered diagnostic criterion is met

benchmark_integrity.requirement: Reproduce the exact deterministic evaluation pools implied by the registered seed formulas; report train/eval and cross-seed overlap exactly as the original run; no post-run selection.

held_constant: model width, head count, expert count, CDL/CASM settings and action count
optimizer and training loss terms other than the preregistered physics-weight intervention
no checkpoint, seed, hyperparameter, or metric selection after observing results
claim_boundary: optimization diagnosis for the registered full-learned benchmark only

arms.name: untrained
arms.intervention: zero optimizer updates on the exact full-learned architecture

arms.name: trained_full
arms.intervention: registered full-learned training protocol including physics prior

arms.name: trained_physics_off
arms.intervention: registered full-learned training protocol with only physics prior weight set to zero
